newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases slowly on T-bill redemptions.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases slowly on T-bill redemptions.

text.p: The rouble edged down on Monday on plentiful supply coming from the Treasury bill market as banks bought dollars with funds from maturing issues, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jan 13 midday Jan 13 early Jan 10 close

"Roubles are getting cheaper slowly, and selling is not feverish," Neftekhimbank dealer Vladimir Zrazhevsky said. Arbitrage was not very attractive, given the near-parity between today and tomorrow rouble rates as well as MICEX rate stability.
Another dealer said rouble supply had been high since the end of December on T-bill redemptions.
"Many roubles came back to the market at the end of 1996 and this pushed rates down," he said.
